issue (cited in the notes as #9070): Argo CD Notifications: the on-deployed trigger will trigger when Progressing instead of only Healthy [closed; labels bug]
I'm using Argo CD v2.3.3 (both client and server) which has the built in notifications functionality.

**Describe the bug**

When using the `on-deployed` trigger which has:

```yaml
- when: app.status.operationState.phase in ['Succeeded'] and app.status.health.status == 'Healthy'
```

**Expected behavior**

The `on-deployed` trigger wouldn't fire because while the app did sync successfully, this deploy is not healthy. Technically the "old" deploy is healthy. The deploy that triggered this event has a pod in an error state while the health is considered "Progressing" not "Healthy" since it can't start (which is expected) which feels like this trigger is giving out false information.

PR (cited in the notes as #21944): fix: On deployed trigger must consider race between last transition time and sync finished time (#9070) [closed; labels ready-for-review]
Fixes #9070

There are cases during legitimate sync/deploy, when the last transition time is like 1 second before the operation finished time. In theory, the gap can be a bit bigger if there are more sync waves that don't do any updates. So giving some more gap of 1 minute.
